identity.name: Cheshire Today
identity.description: A digital-first local news platform that borrows the credibility of print journalism and fuses it with the speed of modern tech. High contrast, serif typography, and bento-grid layouts.

headings.usage: All article titles, section headers, and hero text. Use tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Article content, summaries, and general UI text.

mono.usage: Timestamps, authors, tags, and metadata. Adds a 'wire service' aesthetic.

primary.name: Cheshire Royal
primary.usage: Brand headers, primary buttons, active states.

accent.name: Alert Red
accent.usage: Breaking news badges, urgent CTAs, live indicators.

colors.theme_strategy: Light Mode Default (Paper aesthetic). Dark mode uses deep charcoal (#09090b) instead of pure black.

layout.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Gap-6 for grids.
strategies: Hero section must use a 2/3 + 1/3 split or a full-width featured story.
Sidebar for 'Most Read' and 'Trending' on desktop, stacked on mobile.

buttons.style: Solid rectangles, no rounded corners or very slight (rounded-sm).

badges.style: Outline or solid. Font-mono. Small text.

visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to mimic paper grain (optional).
visual_enhancers.lines: Use 1px horizontal dividers between list items.

hero_landscape.desc: Cheshire landscape for local context/hero background

business_meeting.desc: Diverse office meeting for Business section

breaking_news.desc: Studio background for breaking news or video placeholders

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT implement the full site yet. Create a 'Design Showcase' page or a set of visual components to present to the user.
Use 'Playfair Display' from Google Fonts (via import in index.css).
Create a 'NewsCard' component that accepts an image, category, title, and summary.
Implement a 'Ticker' component for the top bar.
Ensure the 'Bento Grid' is responsive (stack on mobile, grid on desktop).
Use the provided image URLs for the mockups.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯📚🎭🎬🎪🎉🎊🎁🎀🎂🍰🎈🎨🎰💰💵💳🏦💎🪙💸🤑📊📈📉💹🔢🏆🥇 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Components MUST use named exports (export const ComponentName = ...)
Pages MUST use default exports (export default function PageName() {...})
